title: An unrecognized **critical** chunk with a valid CRC
why: The PNG specification requires a decoder to stop on a critical chunk it does not recognise, and a browser obeys it — so skipping one and carrying on reaches a gate verdict where the other side of the contract reaches `decode-failed`. Criticality is the case of the type's first letter, which is why its sibling `ancillary-chunk-crc-is-not-fatal` (a lowercase `tEXt`) must still come out `valid`.
